name: Fushiki Hana
source:
Area: Kanagawa Prefecture

A hardworking nurse working at the hospital [url=/c70696]Shigeru's[/url] father manages, she is often compared to an angel due to her personality.

She happens to be the one who looks after Shigeru after his failed suicide attempt, and ends up becoming his first rape victim as well...
